==Carrier==

*Flares
A set of small rockets. These are deployed as dummy targets to protect the Carrier against missiles.

*Fuel
Used in Carrier engines and as a basic substance for repairing components and vehicles.

*Fuelpack
A pack of Carrier fuel cells. Used in Carrier engines and as a basic substance for repairing components and vehicles.

*Defense drones
Defense Drones protect the Carrier primarily from enemy Walruses. They lock and explode on impact.

*Scout drone
The Scout Drone allows for aerial reconnaissance of an island without being detected.

== Walrus ==

*Repair gun

magazine capacity: 80 / 100%

An energy beam capable of repairing damaged units at short range.

From tutorial. Okoro: Sir, the blueprint we just gained details the construction of a Walrus-mounted &quot;Repair&quot; beam. This beam repairs its target, mending broken welds and damaged plates. It has a limited range, but I strongly recommend we build one and try it out.

*Ammo box
A capsule that stores additional ammunition for the unit, increasing combat capabilities.

*Hacking capsule
A capsule used to re-program the internal systems in an enemy Command Center.

*Resource capsule
The Resource capsule constructs Mining structures, the island then harvests materials.

*Production capsule
The Production capsule constructs Factories, the island is then capable of Production.

*Defense capsule
The Defense capsule constructs Defensive structures, changing the island to Defensive.

== Manta ==

*Hook
The Manta Hook is a system designed for transporting objects and vehicles, primarily Walruses.

*Flares
A set of small rockets. These are deployed as dummy targets against missiles.
